source_record.title: Growth Manager (AI x Renewables) (all genders)
source_record.description:
Your Impact

As our Growth Manager, you’ll help make it happen. Find unexpected ways to reach customers, put a fresh spin on proven channels and turn bold ideas into measurable results. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, the ownership to move fast and a clear mission: discover what brings in customers - then scale it.

Location: Berlin, on-site
Employment type: Full-Time

  • Discover new acquisition opportunities: Find channels, platforms and partnerships that reach our target customers, including places where software companies have little presence today.
  • Reinvent proven channels: Develop fresh approaches to email, LinkedIn, webinars, referrals, events and paid campaigns. Connect them into coordinated journeys that turn interest into action.
  • Launch experiments quickly: Define your audience, hypothesis and success criteria, then get initial tests live within days. Create the content, landing pages and workflows yourself or with the team.
  • Build visibility that generates business: Establish autarc’s presence on industry platforms, in professional communities and through trade associations. Turn that presence into partnerships, joint content, events and qualified opportunities.
  • Reach audiences across markets: Adapt messaging and distribution to national and international audiences. Identify what transfers across markets and what needs a local approach.
  • Measure through to acquisition: Work with sales to track qualified leads, demos and paying customers. Use conversion rates, customer acquisition costs and revenue to assess performance.
  • Scale what works: Stop low-potential experiments, improve promising ones and turn successful tests into repeatable acquisition channels.


What you bring

  • Practical experience in growth, marketing, customer acquisition or building your own business or project.
  • Concrete examples of customers you helped acquire, with measurable results and a clear explanation of your contribution.
  • Creativity in how you approach a challenge and discipline in how you evaluate the outcome.
  • A hands-on approach: you are comfortable writing copy, building a landing page, launching a campaign or initiating a partnership.
  • Confidence working with metrics. You can explain what would make an experiment successful and when you would stop it.
  • The ability to move quickly, prioritise and make progress with incomplete information.
  • Strong communication skills in German and English, with curiosity about different markets and audiences.
  • Experience using AI and automation to test ideas faster and make successful processes more efficient.


What we offer

  • Grow with us: As part of a fast-growing, YC-backed climate tech startup with an ambitious team.
  • Real ownership: Drive your work from idea to impact.
  • Low ego, high trust: No blame, open feedback, collaboration over hierarchy.
  • Be part of the energy transition: Help bring more heat pumps and solar to homes every day.
  • Hybrid work in Berlin-Mitte: 3 days together in our office near Weinbergspark, 2 from home. Need more flexibility? We'll find a way.
  • Modern equipment: MacBook and 27″ monitor.
  • Annual team retreat plus regular team events.
  • Mobility: Dance e-bike or Deutschland-Ticket.
  • Fitness: Urban Sports Club membership.


Next steps

  1. Apply online with your CV. Your contact is Philipp Hulm (Sales Lead).
  2. After reviewing your application, we’ll get back to you about the next steps.
  3. We’ll start with a 30-minute Google Meet interview with someone from our Sales team.
  4. Next, you’ll have a 30-minute Google Meet interview with our founder, Thies.
  5. We’ll then invite you to meet us in person at our Berlin office.
Don’t meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We’d love to get to know you.
